about: Verse is the appraiser (STANDING.md): every price it sets, with its reasoning, newest first. Written by Verse's earn loop (tools/earn.mjs) from what rivals charge (domains/earn.comps.json) and its own sales. Nothing a visitor says moves a price; the owner can change any.
